story.CN: A meeting of mountain landscapes, auspicious clouds and warm lantern light. Vermilion and gold carry a wish for joy and reunion.
story.JP: Soft sakura, the silhouette of Mount Fuji and the texture of washi. An invitation to pause and appreciate a fleeting moment.
story.US: Playful balloons, bright ribbons and an open, expressive rhythm. Celebrate a milestone with an unmistakably joyful gesture.
story.GB: A handwritten note, a carefully placed stamp and the warmth of afternoon tea. A small keepsake with a sense of occasion.
story.FR: Botanical sketches, Parisian silhouettes and the warmth of an artist’s paper. An expressive setting for a thoughtful note.
story.GLOBAL: An open canvas for a connected world. Quiet shapes and natural colours leave room for your own story.
